# Perfuncted v1.4.0

This release expands desktop automation with composable Go workflows, visual and semantic discovery, controlled script execution, and independently verified desktop acceptance tests.

## Automation and input

- Added a unified Go scripting API with composable window-scoped actions, waits, and context cancellation.
- Added timed pointer movement and drag trajectories with configurable easing, curvature, and seeded variation. Wayland virtual input waits for compositor protocol acknowledgement before reporting motion completion.
- Added X11 global hotkey and mouse-button observation, key/button/lock state queries, and authoritative pointer observations with coordinate-space provenance. Unsupported observation paths fail explicitly.

## Screen capture and visual discovery

- Added fuzzy template matching and ordered, bounded multi-match searches, with optional Tesseract OCR through the Go API and CLI.
- Added window-targeted screen captures with identity, geometry, and pixel-coordinate metadata, plus X11 background pixmap capture when supported by the compositor.
- Added bounded dirty-rectangle detection and opt-in screen-watch deltas with metadata or PNG pixel payloads, including full-frame resynchronization.

## Accessibility and execution

- Added semantic accessibility state waits and verified actions, including scoped text mutations and post-action evidence.
- Added named managed desktop sessions with attachment, inspection, stop, and safe stale-reservation recovery.
- Added same-user controlled script workflows with status, pause, resume, stop, and terminal receipts. Failed or canceled operations do not replay mutations.

## Reliability and validation

- Strengthened cancellation, resource cleanup, socket ownership checks, capture bounds, and provider error handling.
- Expanded live acceptance across headless and nested X11 and Wayland, native KWin, GTK/Qt accessibility, and installed Flatpak scenarios.
- Added a mandatory runnable-command acceptance inventory and explicit test-pass checks. Contract coverage is distinguished from native execution; unsupported capabilities remain backend-dependent.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nskaggs/perfuncted/compare/v1.3.2...v1.4.0
